title: How AI is shortening drug discovery timelines in China
summary: Insilico Medicine, a Hong Kong-listed AI drug discovery company, has dramatically shortened drug development timelines in China from traditional multi-year cycles to approximately 9-13 months by combining artificial intelligence with laboratory research, as announced by CEO Alex Zhavoronkov.
problem_solved: Traditional drug discovery typically takes 10-15 years from target identification to market, with candidate nomination alone taking 3-5 years, creating massive time and cost barriers for bringing new treatments to patients.
why_valuable: By reducing candidate nomination timelines from years to months, AI-powered drug discovery can accelerate delivery of life-saving medications to patients while dramatically reducing development costs.
